CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.active_tenant(p_tenant uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (select 1 from public.tenants where id = p_tenant and operational_status = 'active')
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.can_block_from_profile(p_target uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select app_private.verified_user() is not null and p_target<>app_private.verified_user() and (
    exists(select from public.user_account_blocks b where (b.blocker_user_id,b.blocked_user_id)=(app_private.verified_user(),p_target))
    or case current_setting('ct.block_source',true)
      when 'global_profile' then app_private.can_inspect_global_profile(p_target)
        and exists(select from public.user_account_profiles p where p.user_id=p_target)
      when 'community_profile' then exists(
        select from public.community_accounts viewer join public.community_accounts target using(tenant_id)
        join public.community_account_profiles p on (p.tenant_id,p.user_id)=(target.tenant_id,target.user_id)
        join public.tenants t on t.id=target.tenant_id
        where t.id=nullif(current_setting('ct.block_tenant',true),'')::uuid
          and viewer.user_id=app_private.verified_user() and target.user_id=p_target
          and ((t.operational_status='active' and viewer.standing in ('approved','suspended')
            and target.standing in ('approved','suspended','inactive'))
            or (t.operational_status='archived' and app_private.is_approved_owner(t.id))))
      else false end)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.can_discover_global_profile(p_target uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select app_private.verified_user() is not null and exists(select from public.user_accounts u
    where u.user_id=p_target and u.user_is_discoverable)
    and not exists(select from public.user_account_blocks b where
      (b.blocker_user_id,b.blocked_user_id) in ((app_private.verified_user(),p_target),(p_target,app_private.verified_user())))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.can_edit_configuration(p_tenant uuid, p_kind text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists(select from public.tenant_staff_assignments s
    join public.community_accounts c using(tenant_id,user_id) join public.tenants t on t.id=s.tenant_id
    where s.tenant_id=p_tenant and s.user_id=app_private.verified_user() and s.status='active' and c.standing='approved'
      and (s.role='owner' or t.operational_status='active')
      and case p_kind when 'details' then s.role='owner' when 'settings' then s.can_manage_settings
        when 'copy' then s.can_modify_content else false end)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.can_inspect_global_profile(p_target uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select app_private.verified_user() is not null and (p_target=app_private.verified_user() or (
    not exists(select from public.user_account_blocks b where
      (b.blocker_user_id,b.blocked_user_id) in ((app_private.verified_user(),p_target),(p_target,app_private.verified_user())))
    and (exists(select from public.user_accounts u where u.user_id=p_target and u.user_is_discoverable)
      or exists(select from public.community_accounts viewer join public.community_accounts target using(tenant_id)
        join public.community_account_preferences prefs on (prefs.tenant_id,prefs.user_id)=(target.tenant_id,target.user_id)
        join public.tenants t on t.id=target.tenant_id
        where viewer.user_id=app_private.verified_user() and target.user_id=p_target
          and viewer.standing in ('approved','suspended') and target.standing in ('approved','suspended')
          and t.operational_status='active' and prefs.show_global_profile))))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.can_manage_account_records(p_tenant uuid, p_kind text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select p_tenant=app_private.command_scope() and exists(
    select from public.tenant_staff_assignments s join public.community_accounts c using(tenant_id,user_id)
    join public.tenants t on t.id=s.tenant_id
    where s.tenant_id=p_tenant and s.user_id=app_private.verified_user() and s.status='active' and c.standing='approved'
      and (s.role='owner' or t.operational_status='active')
      and case p_kind when 'staff' then s.can_grant_staff when 'participant' then s.can_manage_community_permissions else false end)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.can_read_account_action(p_tenant uuid, p_action uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select p_tenant=app_private.command_scope()
    and exists(select from public.tenant_admin_actions where id=p_action and tenant_id=p_tenant)
    and exists(
    select from public.tenant_staff_assignments s
    join public.community_accounts c using(tenant_id,user_id)
    join public.tenants t on t.id=s.tenant_id
    where s.tenant_id=p_tenant and s.user_id=app_private.verified_user()
      and s.status='active' and c.standing='approved'
      and (s.role='owner' or (t.operational_status='active' and exists(
        select from app_private.tenant_admin_action_categories category where category.action_id=p_action
          and ((category.category='community_account' and s.can_audit_community_accounts)
            or (category.category='staff_account' and s.can_audit_staff_accounts))
      )))
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.command_scope()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case when app_private.verified_user() is not null then nullif(current_setting('ct.tenant_id',true),'')::uuid end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.community_landing(p_slug text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, slug text, name text, country_code text, state_province text, city text, timezone text, auto_approve_users boolean, allow_public_chat_visibility boolean, allow_public_activity_visibility boolean, allow_public_directory_visibility boolean, overrides jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select t.id,t.slug,t.name,t.country_code,t.state_province,t.city,t.timezone,s.auto_approve_users,
    s.allow_public_chat_visibility,s.allow_public_activity_visibility,s.allow_public_directory_visibility,
    coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('tenant_id',o.tenant_id,'content_key',o.content_key,'text_value',o.text_value) order by o.content_key)
      from public.tenant_website_content_overrides o where o.tenant_id=t.id and o.content_key in (
        'community.hero.eyebrow','community.hero.heading','community.hero.description','community.welcome.eyebrow',
        'community.welcome.heading','community.welcome.body','community.welcome.emphasis')),'[]'::jsonb)
  from public.tenants t join public.tenant_settings s on s.tenant_id=t.id
  where t.slug=p_slug and t.operational_status='active'
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.guard_community_sharing()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if tg_table_name='community_accounts' then
    update public.community_account_preferences set show_global_profile=false
      where tenant_id=new.tenant_id and user_id=new.user_id and show_global_profile;
  else
    perform 1 from public.community_accounts where tenant_id=new.tenant_id
      and user_id=new.user_id and standing <> 'inactive' for update;
    if not found then raise exception 'inactive_community_sharing' using errcode='23514'; end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.inspect_global_profile(p_target uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, display_name text, bio text, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone, created_by uuid, updated_by uuid)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select p.user_id,p.display_name,p.bio,p.created_at,p.updated_at,p.created_by,p.updated_by
    from public.user_account_profiles p where p.user_id=p_target and app_private.can_inspect_global_profile(p_target)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.is_approved_owner(p_tenant uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.tenant_staff_assignments s
    join public.community_accounts c using (tenant_id, user_id)
    where s.tenant_id = p_tenant and s.user_id = app_private.verified_user()
      and s.role = 'owner' and s.status = 'active' and c.standing = 'approved'
  )
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.is_staff_candidate(p_tenant uuid, p_target uuid, p_lock boolean)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if p_tenant is distinct from app_private.command_scope() or not exists (
    select from public.tenant_staff_assignments actor join public.tenants t on t.id=actor.tenant_id
    join public.community_accounts target on target.tenant_id=t.id and target.user_id=p_target
    where actor.tenant_id=p_tenant and actor.user_id=app_private.verified_user() and actor.status='active'
      and actor.can_grant_staff and t.operational_status='active' and target.standing='approved'
  ) then return false; end if;
  if p_lock then perform id from auth.users where id=p_target for share; end if;
  return exists(select from auth.users where id=p_target and email is not null and email_confirmed_at is not null
    and not coalesce(is_anonymous,false) and (banned_until is null or banned_until<=now()));
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.lock_eligible_actor()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  perform 1 from auth.users where id = auth.uid()
    and email_confirmed_at is not null and email is not null and not coalesce(is_anonymous, false)
    and (banned_until is null or banned_until <= now()) for share;
  return found;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.my_community_relationships()
 RETURNS TABLE(tenant_id uuid, is_owned boolean, is_managed boolean, is_member boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select c.tenant_id,
    coalesce(s.status='active' and s.role='owner' and c.standing='approved',false),
    coalesce(s.status='active' and c.standing='approved',false),
    c.standing in ('pending','approved','suspended')
  from public.community_accounts c left join public.tenant_staff_assignments s using(tenant_id,user_id)
  where c.user_id=app_private.verified_user() and c.standing in ('pending','approved','suspended')
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.provision_user_account()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.user_accounts(user_id) values (new.id);
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.reject_audit_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin raise exception 'audit_is_append_only' using errcode = '23514'; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.stamp_community_revision()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin new.revision := gen_random_uuid(); return new; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION app_private.verified_user()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select id from auth.users where id = auth.uid() and email_confirmed_at is not null
    and email is not null and not coalesce(is_anonymous,false)
    and (banned_until is null or banned_until <= now())
$function$

policies.qual: ((tenant_id = app_private.command_scope()) AND (((user_id = app_private.verified_user()) AND app_private.active_tenant(tenant_id)) OR app_private.can_manage_account_records(tenant_id, 'participant'::text)))

((user_id = app_private.verified_user()) AND app_private.active_tenant(tenant_id) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT
   FROM community_accounts c
  WHERE (((c.tenant_id = community_account_preferences.tenant_id) AND (c.user_id = community_account_preferences.user_id)) AND (c.standing = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'approved'::text]))))))
(( SELECT app_private.verified_user() AS verified_user) IS NOT NULL)

((user_id = app_private.verified_user()) AND app_private.active_tenant(tenant_id) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT
   FROM community_accounts c
  WHERE (((c.tenant_id = community_account_profiles.tenant_id) AND (c.user_id = community_account_profiles.user_id)) AND (c.standing = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'approved'::text, 'suspended'::text]))))))
(( SELECT app_private.verified_user() AS verified_user) IS NOT NULL)

((tenant_id = app_private.command_scope()) AND (app_private.can_edit_configuration(tenant_id, 'copy'::text) OR (app_private.active_tenant(tenant_id) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT
   FROM community_accounts c
  WHERE (((c.tenant_id = tenant_website_content_overrides.tenant_id) AND (c.user_id = app_private.verified_user())) AND (c.standing = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'suspended'::text]))))))))

(id IN ( SELECT my_community_relationships.tenant_id
   FROM app_private.my_community_relationships() my_community_relationships(tenant_id, is_owned, is_managed, is_member)))
